about_the_game:
No fantasy game is complete without some fantastic creatures for fights, and in our second team up with artist Gtox we bring you some new critters to do battle with and give your games that extra quality. The GameGuru MAX Dungeon Denizens booster pack contains 10 fully scripted and animated creatures, complete with full audio, ready to be dropped into your games.

Of course, you don't need to restrict these assets to fantasy games, they will be just at home and ideally suited to Wasteland, Dystopian and even Steampunk games!

Included in this booster pack you'll find:

1 x Beetle Larva
1 x Giant Centipede
1 x Giant Cicada
1 x Hound
1 x Giant Rat
1 x Salamander
1 x Scarab Beetle
1 x Giant Spider
1 x Solider Termite
1 x Giant Cricket

Dream it! Build it! Play it!
